bridges.narrative: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.
bridges.remaining_gap: CISA has not yet published a dedicated agentic-AI workflow secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify; the artifact is not on file.

bridges.narrative: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 deserialization RCE in the agent-task-checkpoint loader and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 unauthenticated path-traversal in the deepset-cloud agent-tool registry land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM, both added to the OWASP GenAI Exploit feed within hours. Aikido and Sysdig flag at least seven additional unmaintained agent-checkpoint loaders with structurally similar exposure, supplying the multi-vendor weekly cadence the CSAI sub-corpus requires.
bridges.remaining_gap: No CSAI CNA pull-quarter count or skill-marketplace signed-and-provenance-attested gate publishes today; cadence is operational but the named sub-corpus and gate are pending.

bridges.narrative: Unsloth's joint arxiv preprint on router-only LoRA across Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, and Kimi K2.6 recovers 71-78% of full-LoRA accuracy at 8-13% step-time and 11-16% peak VRAM, with three follow-on recipes plus a DeepMind preprint closing long-context RL stability. Cerebras CS-4 cites the paper as target workload — exactly what a Bedrock / Foundry / Vertex tier productizes.
bridges.remaining_gap: No hyperscaler announces a managed Unsloth-as-a-service fine-tuning offering on Bedrock, Foundry, or Vertex today; the technical envelope hardens but productization is not yet announced.

bridges.narrative: AMD's 8-K confirms 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 H2 2026 commitments across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI 1GW, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus an undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment. Nvidia's parallel 8-K on Vera Rubin production-volume commitments at nine of the top-ten hyperscalers tightens the comparable, while SEC Corp Fin's sample letter to Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta sharpens the Q2 10-Q bar.
bridges.remaining_gap: AMD has not yet committed to publishing an MI300 / MI325 / MI450 split from EPYC in the 10-Q segment footnote schedule; the issuer-side commitment remains unannounced.

bridges.narrative: AMD's 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 commitment book, the undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud Asia-Pacific deployment exposing the export-control disclosure asymmetry the prediction names, Nvidia's Vera Rubin 8-K backlog comparable, and the Cerebras IPO first-day $31.4B market cap putting a public-market multiple under disclosed accelerator revenue all sharpen the buyside case for a Q2 10-Q accelerator-only revenue plus ASP line.
bridges.remaining_gap: AMD has not committed to publishing the segment breakout schedule; the disclosure-pressure stack hardens but no chip vendor has issuer-side scheduled the AI-accelerator-only footnote yet.

bridges.narrative: Tesla's 8-K confirms low-volume Optimus Gen 3 production at Fremont two months ahead of schedule, with 240 units for internal cell-pickup plus torque-fastening and 60 for an undisclosed Stellantis Detroit pilot. Paired with Figure 03 at BMW, Apptronik Apollo at Mercedes Sindelfingen, plus Boston Dynamics Atlas at Hyundai Steel, Kia Slovak, and LG Energy Solution, four-OEM cadence hardens pressure.
bridges.remaining_gap: Neither Tesla nor any Mag-7 issuer publishes a physical-AI revenue or capex segment footnote today; the OEM-adoption record advances but the issuer-side disclosure venue remains unused.

bridges.narrative: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 at Fremont plus the Stellantis Detroit pilot, plus Boston Dynamics Atlas's 60-unit Hyundai Steel Dangjin hot-rolled-coil deployment, 24-unit Kia Slovak Zilina paint-line, and LG Energy Solution Holland Michigan battery cell-stacking pilot at 2.6x average per-unit MTBF improvement, give the IROS / GTC Fall 2026 league table its fourth and fifth entries alongside Figure 03 and Apollo.
